mapper.insert: /* insertBatch */ INSERT INTO sys_batch_config ( bat_nm, job_class, cron_expr, use_yn, sort_sn, desc_txt, crt_user_id, crt_date, upt_user_id, upt_date ) VALUES ( #{bat_nm}, #{bat_cls_nm}, COALESCE(#{cron_expr}, '0 0 0 * * ?'), COALESCE(#{use_yn}, 'Y'), COALESCE(#{sort_sn}, 0), #{desc_txt}, #{sess_user_id}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{sess_user_id}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_batch_config SET use_yn = 'N' ,upt_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE bat_id = #{batId}
mapper.insert: /* insertBatchRunHis */ INSERT INTO sys_batch_run_his ( bat_id, start_dtm, rslt_cd, rslt_txt, crt_user_id, crt_date ) VALUES ( #{bat_id}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{rslt_cd}, #{rslt_txt}, #{sess_user_id}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: /* abortStaleBatchRunHis */ UPDATE sys_batch_run_his SET end_dtm = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, rslt_cd = 'ABORTED', rslt_txt = COALESCE(rslt_txt, '') || E'\n[' || to_char(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || E'] [auto] RUNNING 상태가 ' || #{staleHours} || E'시간 초과 — 프로세스 종료·이력 갱신 실패로 추정.' WHERE rslt_cd = 'RUNNING' AND start_dtm < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (CAST(#{staleHours} AS text) || ' hours')::interval
mapper.select: /* selectBatchRunHisDetail */ SELECT run_sn as bat_exe_log_sn, bat_id, start_dtm as exe_dtm, end_dtm, rslt_cd, rslt_txt, crt_user_id, crt_date FROM sys_batch_run_his WHERE run_sn = #{runSn}
/* selectBatHisList */ SELECT run_sn as bat_exe_log_sn, bat_id, start_dtm as exe_dtm, end_dtm, rslt_cd, rslt_txt FROM sys_batch_run_his WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY run_sn DESC LIMIT 1000
/* selectBatchList */ SELECT run_sn as bat_exe_log_sn, bat_id, start_dtm as exe_dtm, end_dtm, rslt_cd, rslt_txt FROM sys_batch_run_his WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY run_sn DESC LIMIT 1000
